meta.title: fix: optimize user deletion process with queue-based system

core_change_summary.description: Introduced a deletion_queue table and process_deletion_queue Edge function. Updated the on_user_delete trigger to enqueue deletions and use a 25‑second timeout. Optimized the delete_user SQL function and added a sole‑admin‑orgs helper. Included basic user‑deletion tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes directly support the queue‑based deletion performance claim.
